paragraphs: I'm an architect and scenographer, graduated from Faculdade de Belas Artes de São Paulo. Before designing spaces, I learned to see them through light: I started my career in 2007 immersed in the world of **lighting design**, working at DL Iluminação, Havells-Sylvania, Godoy Luminotecnia, and Danica Termoindustrial. That's where a way of thinking about architecture that I still carry today comes from: attention to **space, light, and materiality** as part of a single creative reasoning, always in dialogue with the environment and surroundings where each project takes place.

Starting in 2014, leading event production and brand activations at **Casa Caucaia**, under the creative direction of Renato Kubliokwski, I developed scenographic solutions for brands like Coca-Cola, Samsung, Google, Renault, Oakley, L'Occitane, HBO, and Hotel Fasano — projects that demanded **creative ideas under tight deadlines** and coordinating multidisciplinary teams from concept to execution.

In 2016, I lived one of the most intense moments of my career: leading two projects tied to the **Rio Olympics** in parallel — the Swiss House, for GTM Cenografia, and the Mercedes-Benz, Fiat, and Chery booths at the Auto Show, for MChecon. Two teams, two rhythms, the same commitment to **delivery quality**.

Between 2016 and 2021, I led the management and restructuring of my family's rural business, an experience that taught me to **delegate with confidence** and lead teams outside the creative world. In 2021, I resumed my professional life in São Paulo, in a fresh start that also included original projects for São Paulo's nightlife scene, such as Sayuri and Mariposa, where I signed **concept and scenography** from start to finish.

Between 2022 and 2023, at **tm1**, I worked in live marketing for accounts like Meta, Netflix, Vale, XP, Bayer, Adidas, Chanel/Microsoft, and Call of Duty, further expanding my repertoire of **large-scale projects**, always aligned with the particularities of each brand, audience, and territory.

Today, leading **Estúdio Dorama**, I offer complete creative consulting: from concept to executive project, uniting architecture, scenography, and strategic vision. I keep working the same way I learned over these years — listening to each place's context, proposing **tailor-made creative solutions**, and leading teams with clarity, so that every project comes off the page with the same quality it was conceived with.
